title: Service Intervals, Warranties and Useful Lifetime: Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces
content:
The field service schedule for Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces sets, per bed class: the calendar months between preventive maintenance visits; the reasonable useful lifetime counted from the delivery date (calendar months); the manufacturer frame warranty counted from the delivery date (calendar months); the manufacturer warranty on motors and hand pendant counted from the delivery date (calendar months), 0 when no electrical parts; the labor rate per 15-minute unit on a repair of an owned bed (US dollars); the repair cost, as a percentage of the fee-schedule purchase amount, above which the bed is replaced; the business days within which a malfunctioning rented bed is repaired or swapped; and whether replacement for loss or theft before the end of the useful lifetime requires a report.

| Bed class | Maintenance interval | Useful lifetime from delivery | Frame warranty from delivery | Motor and hand pendant warranty from delivery | Labor rate per 15-minute unit | Repair cost limit (percent of purchase amount) | Rented bed repaired or swapped within | Report required for loss or theft replacement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fixed-Height Hospital Bed (E0250) | 12 months | 60 months | 60 months | 0 months | $23.86 | 100 percent | 1 business day | Yes |
| Variable-Height Hospital Bed (E0255) | 12 months | 60 months | 60 months | 0 months | $23.86 | 100 percent | 1 business day | Yes |
| Semi-Electric Hospital Bed (E0260) | 12 months | 60 months | 60 months | 12 months | $23.86 | 100 percent | 1 business day | Yes |
| Total Electric Hospital Bed (E0265) | 12 months | 60 months | 60 months | 12 months | $23.86 | 100 percent | 1 business day | Yes |
| Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0303) | 12 months | 60 months | 60 months | 0 months | $23.86 | 100 percent | 2 business days | Yes |
| Extra Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0304) | 6 months | 60 months | 60 months | 12 months | $23.86 | 100 percent | 2 business days | Yes |

## Schedule notes

- Preventive maintenance falls every 12 calendar months for five classes and every 6 calendar months for the Extra Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0304).
- The useful lifetime and the frame warranty are both 60 calendar months from the delivery date in every class.
- The motor and hand pendant warranty is 12 calendar months from the delivery date for the Semi-Electric, Total Electric and Extra Heavy-Duty classes, and 0 for the Fixed-Height, Variable-Height and Heavy-Duty classes.
- The labor rate is $23.86 per 15-minute unit, and the repair cost limit is 100 percent of the class's fee-schedule purchase amount, in every class.
- A malfunctioning rented bed is repaired or swapped within 1 business day for the four 36-inch classes and within 2 business days for the Heavy-Duty and Extra Heavy-Duty classes.
